stem: Which statement is an example of how carbon moves through a food chain as part of the carbon cycle?

options.label: F
options.text: Producers release carbon dioxide, and consumers take it in.

options.label: G
options.text: Producers take in carbon dioxide, and consumers release it.

options.label: H
options.text: Producers take in carbon from the soil, and they release it when they decompose.

options.label: J
options.text: Producers release carbon into the soil, and consumers take it in from the soil.
